python3 - <<'PY'
import json,mmap,pathlib,os
raw=pathlib.Path('inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw')
vp=pathlib.Path('store/jobs/j000109/out/version-strings.txt')
text=vp.read_text(errors='replace')
need=['KeePass Password Safe 2','2.53.1']
out={'version_output':str(vp),'version_output_checks':{s:(s in text) for s in need},'raw_size':raw.stat().st_size,'raw_offsets':{}}
with raw.open('rb') as f:
 m=mmap.mmap(f.fileno(),0,access=mmap.ACCESS_READ)
 for s in need:
  out['raw_offsets'][s]={'ascii':m.find(s.encode()),'utf16le':m.find(s.encode('utf-16le'))}
 m.close()
out['all_version_output_checks']=all(out['version_output_checks'].values())
path=pathlib.Path(os.environ['OUT'])/'q3-coverage-route.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
PY
